name: Django5 / Htmx / Alpine / Tailwind
description: Batteries-included server-rendered stack: Django 5.2 LTS (Python 3.13) owns the ORM/migrations, auto-generated admin (paradigm showcase), declarative forms, and the full session auth machinery (HttpOnly SameSite cookie, server-side revocation, fixation-safe login); htmx 2 partial responses drive the four screens with the Stack-04 htmx-config lesson applied (422/429 bodies swap); a custom in-process failed-login throttle returns 429 + Retry-After with trusted-proxy-aware client-IP resolution; the /api/v1 JSON surface uses the {ok,data,error,requestId} envelope with validated X-Request-Id echo; Tailwind 3.4 is pre-built and committed (no runtime CDN) and htmx/Alpine are vendored.
